rules.conflict_note: Page names SB 329 and FEHA but no codified section; criminal-history regulations are named only as 'California regulations' with no cite, so no separate record.
rules.citation: Cal. SB 329 (2019), Fair Employment and Housing Act
rules.title: California bar on refusing Section 8 vouchers (source of income)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not refuse to participate in government housing subsidy programs such as Section 8; blanket 'No Section 8' policies are unlawful. Credit history may not be used against subsidy holders without offering alternative proof of ability to pay (SB 267).
rules.key_value: 'source of income' includes Section 8 vouchers; no 'No Section 8' policies
rules.quoted_span: state law prohibits landlords from refusing to participate in such programs.

notes: Only the source-of-income rule has a citable statute on the page (SB 329, FEHA). Criminal-history limits are regulations (Civil Rights Council, eff. 2020-01-01) with no section cited; not emitted. Codified cite not on page.
